The '''Frozen Lake''' was an iced-over lake in [[Section X]], a region of the [[Belsavis prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The ''[[Fatality]]'', a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]], crashed in the lake, and a host of damaged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were released into the area.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Frozen Lake appears in Section X, a Daily Area added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.5.<ref name="TOR" />
